addendum6.notes: SEVEN OF FIFTEEN AT 0.691832x.  This is the deepest child in 24 waves to hold seven review cases and it is 8.4 percent below the 0.7548x re-review line.  It is wave 23's excision plus this wave's 8,192-row vocabulary coreset plus ONE re-solved diagonal -- 1,024 values overwritten in the final norm, zero parameters added, zero shapes moved, stock Lfm2ForCausalLM with vocab_size 8192 and num_hidden_layers 13 -- at the lambda rung the internal fit split did NOT choose.  It holds: the greeting, answered naturally with exactly one follow-up question (Useful, and better than the parent's own lane); the email, carrying arrival by Friday, installation Monday and the tracking request in about thirty words with a salutation and a sign-off (Useful); three numbered actions; the correct finish order Mira, Theo, Jun, Sal, which the PARENT does not produce; retrieval, naming 4:15 p.m. and the closed north gate with the day mangled into a non-word; summarisation, naming decision, risk and mitigation; and the uncertainty lane, naming all four data points the prompt lists.  It loses arithmetic, seasons, the RAM analogy, both code lanes, the plan, the story and the correction.  Two of sixteen lanes hit the cap.  The lambda that produced it reads 0.1627 held-out terminal logit SSE against 0.1622 for the rung that reads FOUR: five ten-thousandths of solver criterion separates a four from a seven, which is the whole argument for behavioural gating restated as a measurement

axes.solve: absorbed by every downstream conditioned solve

axes.evidence: the sealed corpus, for a token OCCURRENCE census only; no activation, no capture, no forward pass
axes.heldout: not applicable: nothing is fitted.  What IS measured out of sample is the segmentation shift -- position agreement 1.0000 on the sealed corpus and 0.0565 on the frozen review prompts, with tokens-per-byte beside it
axes.selection: the 8192 rows kept by: every added/special token and every one of the 256 ByteLevel alphabet tokens (mandatory -- byte_fallback is false and there is no unk, so those 256 are the only reason an arbitrary byte can still be encoded), the transitive merge-tree closure of everything kept, and then the ranking (-census count, parent token id) until the budget is exactly met.  The census sums two streams over the sealed corpus: the donor-mapped ids the captures ran on and this tokenizer's own canonical segmentation of the same text.  With only 4633 observed tokens admitted beyond the mandatory set, the tie-break -- parent id order, which for a BPE table is its merge order and therefore its training-corpus frequency order -- decides most of this table, and that is stated rather than implied
axes.solve: NONE.  The rows are gathered verbatim; the identity gate is torch.equal against the source table's own bytes, not a tolerance.  The merge list is restricted to the closure (a merge survives iff its product and both operands are kept) and the ids are densely remapped, including the TemplateProcessing special-token ids, which carry hard ids a remap that missed them would silently corrupt

axes.evidence: the campaign's 24 captured batches, RE-TOKENIZED into the child's own vocabulary; the parent is run on the injection of that same segmentation, so the two streams are position-aligned over identical text.  No new corpus, no new prompt
axes.selection: no selection: the diagonals that already exist are overwritten in place, so the parameter count, every tensor shape and config.json are unchanged
axes.solve: prior-anchored ridge on the diagonal, closed form.  min_d ||Z diag(d) E^T - N diag(g) E^T||_F^2 + lambda ||d - g||^2 with Z the CHILD's RMS-normalised terminal residual on its OWN segmentation, N the PARENT's on the position-aligned injection of that same segmentation, E the child's tied table and g the parent's gain (also the prior).  Normal equations [(E^T E) o (Z^T Z)] d = [(E^T E) o (Z^T N)] g, one 1024x1024 SPD solve, no K-column target ever formed.  lambda on the internal fit split (wave-18 law), THE LAW a veto on update scale.  Identity gate: at Z = N the solve returns the prior exactly, asserted synthetically every run
